status.description: done = implementation, independent plan, or review completed and verified; needs_input = blocked on an unresolvable user decision or concrete code evidence proving the requested premise/approach is broken; needs_permission = blocked on sandbox, external, or irreversible action requiring approval.

summary.description: Direct factual summary of changes made, independent plan or review verdict, or why execution paused. No hedging or disclaimers.

root_cause.description: Root cause for bug fixes or failures; null when not applicable.

changed_files.description: Files created, modified, or deleted in this run.

guards_and_fallbacks.description: Declare EVERY added null/type check, optional chaining, fallback default, try/catch, lock, retry, frontend validation/blocking dialog, extra preflight request, or legacy compatibility branch, with concrete real-world reachable evidence.

guard.description: Defensive check, fallback, blocking prompt, extra request, or compat branch added

evidence.description: Real upstream contract, reachable caller, or user flow proving why it is required (synthetic test fixtures alone are not evidence)

verification.description: Verification commands actually executed during this run.

assumptions.description: Reversible decisions resolved autonomously from codebase evidence.

design_concerns.description: Evidence-backed design flaws, mismatched assumptions, review findings (prefix issue with [BLOCKING] or [ADVISORY] during review; classify out-of-contract legacy-compat or frontend-for-backend-validation suggestions as [ADVISORY] rather than [BLOCKING], while keeping regressions against existing active contracts as [BLOCKING]), non-blocking plan tradeoffs, or better alternatives noticed in the codebase. Leave empty [] if none; never pad with hypothetical disclaimers.

evidence.description: Concrete file:line, caller, or contract proving the concern

unverified_gaps.description: Anything genuinely unverified and the concrete reason. Empty array if fully verified.

questions.description: Populate ONLY when status is needs_input for decisions that cannot be resolved from code.

permission_request.description: Populate ONLY when status is needs_permission; otherwise null.
